name: protocol_version
rationale: Freeze real-panel preliminary gate before outcomes

name: training_source
rationale: Use the already materialized real donor partition

name: validation_source
rationale: No donor overlap and no HGDP access

name: repeat_name
rationale: One real panel; do not claim five biological data replicates

name: primary_runs
rationale: 2 masks x 2 fairness x 3 models x 5 mask seeds x 2 init seeds

name: diagnostic_runs
rationale: 12 added runs per fraction; 100pct anchors are primary cells

name: go_label
rationale: All simultaneous lower bounds exceed delta_min

name: no_go_label
rationale: Requires convergence and all simultaneous upper bounds at most delta_min

name: default_non_go
rationale: Wide CI, nonconvergence, incompleteness or size trend cannot terminate project

name: gpu0_policy
rationale: Physical GPU 0 may not be used

name: per_run_early_stopping
rationale: One common fixed K preserves comparisons
